name: Suriyothai
role: Queen consort to the King of Ayutthaya
contribution: A queen consort of the Ayutthaya Kingdom during the 16th century.

checks.lead: Suriyothai (Thai: สุริโยทัย, Thai pronunciation: [sùʔ.ríʔ.jōː.tʰāj], Suriyodaya; Burmese: သူရိယောဒယ) was a queen consort of the Ayutthaya Kingdom during the 16th century. She is famous for sacrificing her life in defense of her husband, King Maha Chakkraphat, during a battle of the Burmese–Siamese War (1547–1549).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
